http_status.description: HTTP status the site returned: 401, 402, 403, 407, 408, 429, 451 or 500-599. Leave out if unknown.
http_status.title: Http Status

AgentVendor.description:
D48 lookup parameter: the vendor whose documented robots.txt token the caller's own web requests send
(access_profile.AGENT_VENDORS, plus other). Not the model vendor, and unrelated to the report field agent_family.
AgentVendor.title: AgentVendor

AhnCheck.description:
D67: the outcome of AHN's own server's check of the host's home page, as codes. Information only; it is added after
the recommendation is decided and changes none of it. Fields that do not apply are left out, never null.
AhnCheck.title: AhnCheck

ApiCatalog.description: /.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727). Fields other than status and source_url appear only when declared.
ApiCatalog.title: ApiCatalog

CatalogApi.description: One API of an RFC 9727 catalog: its anchor and RFC 8631 links as published (at most 3 per relation).
CatalogApi.title: CatalogApi

ContentSignals.description: Cloudflare Content Signals, normalized; `use` is Cloudflare's experimental fourth signal.
ContentSignals.title: ContentSignals

ContentUsage.description: IETF AIPREF preferences (draft-ietf-aipref-vocab-08 categories), y/n normalized to yes/no.
ContentUsage.title: ContentUsage

ContentUseCompact.description: Nothing declared, or the file could not be read: the short shape, without the note and vocabulary strings.
ContentUseCompact.title: ContentUseCompact

Feedback.description: D58: a one-time token for saying, later, whether the next attempt worked (POST /v1/feedback, MCP rate_last_lookup).
Feedback.title: Feedback

FeedbackOutcome.description: D58: what happened on the caller's next attempt after a blocked lookup. "Not tried" is never sent: no answer is that.
FeedbackOutcome.title: FeedbackOutcome

FeedbackPath.description: D58: which way the attempt that the outcome is about went.
FeedbackPath.title: FeedbackPath

GovernmentRegistry.description: Which public government domain list names this domain, as of which version. A fact about the domain, not a judgement.
GovernmentRegistry.title: GovernmentRegistry

McpDiscovery.description: Experimental: MCP Server Card entries of the host's /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (MCP SEP-2127 discovery).
McpDiscovery.title: McpDiscovery

NextAction.description: D51: what to do now, computed from the recommendation (never a second verdict).
NextAction.title: NextAction

SiteDeclared.description: What the host publishes for agents at standard locations (D59); information only, never in the recommendation.
SiteDeclared.title: SiteDeclared

TdmHeader.description: tdm-reservation / tdm-policy response headers seen on the response to one of the files read.
TdmHeader.title: TdmHeader

TdmReservation.description: /.well-known/tdmrep.json and TDM response headers (W3C TDMRep). Quoted as declared, never a legal reading.
TdmReservation.title: TdmReservation

token.description: The feedback_token.token value from the check_incident answer, unchanged.
token.title: Token
